bug_semantics: Diffable.diff forwards **kwargs into git diff/diff-tree with no check_unsafe_options and inserts the caller-supplied other ref before the -- separator. git diff --output=<path> (via output= kwarg or other='--output=...') therefore writes patch content to an attacker-chosen filesystem path (arbitrary file overwrite at process privilege). Diffable is mixed into Commit, Tree, IndexFile, and Submodule.
flaw_origin: b372e26366348920eae32ee81a47b469b511a21f first added Diffable.diff in lib/git/objects/base.py as git.diff(*args, **kwargs) with args.insert(0, other) when other is not None, documenting kwargs as extra git-diff options. Parent bb24f67e64b4ebe11c4d3ce7df021a6ad7ca98f2 still had Commit.diff(cls, repo, a, b=None, paths=None) without kwargs forwarding or pre-separator other insertion. Later moves (aed099a7 into git/diff.py, cb68eef0 package layout, ea33fe8b Index mixin) are not first-writes of the unguarded sink.
ai_marker: absent; author/committer Sebastian Thiel <byronimo@gmail.com>; commit body has no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot trailers
evidence: First-party GHSA-fjr4-x663-mwxc (https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-fjr4-x663-mwxc) and GHSA-6cm2-456v-hrq7/CVE-2026-73624: Diffable.diff has no check_unsafe_options; other is inserted pre-'--'. At tag 3.1.53 git/diff.py Diffable.diff (around 188-277) still does args.insert(0, other) then proc = diff_cmd(*self._process_diff_args(args), **kwargs) with no guard. git show b372e263:lib/git/objects/base.py Diffable.diff already has kwargs forwarding and args.insert(0, other); git grep 'class Diffable' bb24f67e -- '*.py' has no Diffable interface. git log -S 'check_unsafe_options' -- git/diff.py first hits the fix. Fix 1d51b891d7f236044a6aa17498ec682b63dad6e6 ('fix: guard diff output options') adds allow_unsafe_options and Git.check_unsafe_options(_option_candidates([other], kwargs), unsafe_git_revision_options which includes --output); parent ffcb5359e87619f4fe4a70a4aff5f08c5580ba97 is still unguarded. git merge-base --is-ancestor b372e263 3.1.53 succeeds; 1d51b891 is ancestor of 3.1.54 and not of 3.1.53. 1d51b891 author is GPT 5.6 (AI on the fix only). b372e263 is single-parent (no ^2). ppa re-checked line-level 2026-08-29: numactl git show b372e26^:lib/git/objects/base.py | grep -c 'def diff' = 0 while BIC b372e26 adds 'def diff(self, other=None, paths=None, create_patch=False, **kwargs)' at line 189 with 'args.insert(0, other)' at 232 — vulnerable Diffable.diff introduced by BIC. -> introducer_parent_absent=true.

Subsequent file moves and Index mixin work preserve that sink. AI is judged only on that BIC: human author Sebastian Thiel, no AI trailers. AI authorship on the 3.1.54 fix does not attribute the BIC.
